PART VI VI. Read these stories. Then circle the correct answer.

Read the two short stories and choose the best answers.

“Gramps has a bag of soap. Dan can wash a sock. Dan and Gramps can wash and clean.”
1. What does Gramps have?
a. a bag of soap
b. a sock
Answer: a. a bag of soap (Gramps has a bag of soap)
2. What can Dan do?
a. wash a sock
b. wash a shirt
Answer: a. wash a sock (Dan can wash a sock)
3. What can Dan and Gramps do?
a. sit and wait
b. wash and clean
Answer: b. wash and clean (Dan and Gramps can wash and clean)
“Mom and Dad live in a house. Five people can fit in the house. It has a den and a desk. The house is red and yellow.”
1. Where do Mom and Dad live?
a. in an apartment
b. in a house
Answer: b. in a house (Mom and Dad live in a house)
2. How many people can fit in the house?
a. five people
b. four people
Answer: a. five people (Five people can fit in the house)
3. What color is the house?
a. red and yellow
b. red and black
Answer: a. red and yellow (The house is red and yellow)
